notes.title: Play now: One Card One Shot - Mafia demo!
notes.content:
[h1][b]THE ONE CARD ONE SHOT - MAFIA DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW![/b][/h1]
We're thrilled (and a bit nervous) to announce: the demo for One Card One Shot – Mafia is now available to play on Steam!
Get ready to dive into a world where strategy, action, and explosive cards collide in intense battles against the mafia.

[b]Available from April 30 to May 4.[/b]

[h3][b]TRY THE DEMO AT GAMESCOM LATAM TOO![/b][/h3]
Swinging by [b]Gamescom Latam[/b]? Don’t miss this: the demo will also be playable at the Xbox and Panorama Brasil booths!
[b]This is your chance to test the game before everyone else — and even score a launch key. Don’t sleep on it![/b]

[h3][b]IN ONE CARD ONE SHOT – MAFIA, YOU WILL:[/b][/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Build a badass deck with cards that deal damage, protect your skin, or throw creative (sometimes totally chaotic) twists into the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/5f47cb113308c27fb2fa2b2e428408f08ab4a377.gif[/img]

[*] Face enemies that never let up. They attack, defend, and make you rethink your choices… kind of like adult life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/f7ca1689b1927b4c0d6d5fda4729906bdb0b6b6e.gif[/img]

[*] Use secondary weapons at just the right moment to turn the tide when all seems lost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/9f8562f855965c07878ad026b0e43ede00e4f407.gif[/img]

[*] Watch out — enemies literally fall from the sky. No metaphor here. One minute it’s calm, the next you’re staring at airborne thugs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/a9faca228ebfb71c1049856d9e6b48c50090f72d.gif[/img]

[*] Think you’ve got everything under control… until the fireworks start. Dynamite flies in from all directions and you scramble to defuse them — just don’t shoot one by accident. (We tried. Wouldn’t recommend it.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/7f9174bb890a682aa0ca542d59819428160cfaab.gif[/img]

[*] Tackle fast-paced mechanics in both 3D and top-down shooter styles — because the heat comes from every direction here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43718225/53d5d62a1b9a8663778528ca032bd8ce4de862bf.gif[/img]
[/list][/b]

[b]We truly appreciate your support — thank you!
This project is built with tons of passion (and probably too much caffeine), and having the community with us means everything.[/b]

Send us your feedback, your ideas, and even your most embarrassing defeats (we promise to laugh respectfully).
Join our Discord, follow us on social media, and wishlist the game on Steam so you don’t miss a thing!

Thanks so much — and good luck facing the mafia (you’re gonna need it). ♡

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2332120/One_Card_One_Shot__Mafia/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Rbwh_aQBJg

notes.title: Survivor Cells Update is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/1f69c8bd06a08832c78041f63b8cf868cbc56b65.png[/img]

[b]Survivor Cells[/b] has just received a fantastic update! Get ready to explore all the new features and take your gaming experience to the next level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/7b2b7db2ffb2784f934334bc9ec7ab5131c748e9.gif[/img]

[b]- New Game Mode: Endless[/b]  
Now you can test your limits in the new [b]Endless[/b] mode! Survive as long as possible against endless waves of enemies in a never-ending gameplay experience. Start the mode already at Year 100 with upgrades purchased in the laboratory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/fc38ae8490b7bc7e1233db916cedded37b50ef42.gif[/img]

[b]- Alchemy Improvements[/b]  
The Alchemy system has been refined, making strategy creation even more dynamic. Adjusting your build during gameplay is now more intuitive and effective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/ad3a7fe3179e7392b551be77af6dec16efa4cb1d.gif[/img]

[b]- Laboratory Enhancements[/b]  
The Laboratory has been updated to make managing your cells and resources easier, making your decisions more strategic and practical.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/e34e423cf05c1842f9a60f3254041c405ed764bb.gif[/img]

[b]- Various Fixes and Gameplay & Navigation Improvements[/b]  
We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements that make gameplay and navigation smoother and more engaging, ensuring a more enjoyable experience.

[b]- New SFX[/b]  
To further enhance your immersion, we've added new sound effects that will make your battles even more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/16cfe50711f9e65f590827764194d75799503578.gif[/img]

Update your game now and enjoy all these improvements!  
Get ready to face new challenges and take your survival to the next level!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976100/Survivor_Cells/
